newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 2.9 bln dong T-notes, rate 8.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 2.9 bln dong T-notes, rate 8.00 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 2.9 billion dong ($262,000) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 8.00 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper on November 13, the central bank issued 14 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 7.89 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is November 22, 1996 and maturity will be on November 22, 1997.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 2.0 billion
